overview: Video is usually the format most likely to actually hold someone's attention, but only when it's produced for where it will be watched. This page covers our commercial video offer as a whole — how one production is planned to work across advertising, social and your website, and how it fits with the rest of your marketing across Koh Phangan, Koh Samui and Koh Tao.

Our dedicated commercial video service, under Video Production, goes deep on the concept-and-story process for a single brand film. This page is the broader view: who commercial video is for, how distribution shapes the production, and how it connects to the advertising, social and photography services around it.

A single well-planned commercial shoot can supply a paid advertising cut, several shorter social versions and a website hero video, because each of those is considered before filming starts — not decided afterward when the footage is already locked to one aspect ratio. That planning matters even more for off-island production, where a Koh Samui or Koh Tao shoot involves a boat crossing and a travel fee, and getting everything needed in one visit is genuinely more efficient than returning for a second cut.

We treat commercial video as part of a wider system rather than a stand-alone deliverable: the same footage and brand direction can inform Meta Ads creative, feed your social channels and sit on your homepage, so a business isn't commissioning three separate video projects to cover three separate needs.

faqs.q: Do you produce commercial video on Koh Samui and Koh Tao, or only Koh Phangan?
faqs.a: All three — production is based on Koh Phangan and we travel by boat for shoots on Koh Samui and Koh Tao, with a travel fee factored into off-island quotes.

faqs.q: How is commercial video different from social video?
faqs.a: Commercial video is produced for advertising, brand storytelling and web use with longer, more deliberate cuts; social video is built specifically for short-form, vertical platform viewing.

faqs.q: Can the same production be cut for both advertising and social media?
faqs.a: Yes — planning multiple formats from the brief stage is exactly what makes one shoot cover several destinations.

faqs.q: Do you include drone or aerial footage?
faqs.a: It can be added where a project calls for it, coordinated with our drone and FPV video services.

faqs.q: What do we need to provide before the shoot?
faqs.a: Your goals, timeline and any existing brand assets — we can develop the concept, script and shot list from there.

faqs.q: How long does a commercial video project take end to end?
faqs.a: Typically 3–6 weeks from brief to final delivery, depending on production complexity and how many locations are involved.

faqs.q: Can this replace the need for a separate photographer too?
faqs.a: Video and photography are usually planned as separate productions, though they're often scheduled around the same location visit where that makes sense.

faqs.q: Is there a minimum production budget?
faqs.a: We scope each project individually — tell us your budget range and goals and we'll advise what's realistic within it.
